_: The five findings of the lapis (Monitoring) hero, in the exact keys of findings-screening.json. Provenance: every figure in a/b/cote is a cell of ~/Documents/cascade-monitoring/releve-public.json at seal `sceau`; the builder refuses to build if the record on disk no longer matches. Each figure keeps its cell address in `source` ({table, palier, seuil, mesure} or {table, compte}); the optional `champ` names which field of the Rate is displayed when it is not `taux` (finding 03 displays lower bounds: champ = 'bas'). Builders may ignore `source`; reviewers and guards re-derive every number from it. The tool's rule behind finding 03 is the same as the whole suite: Wilson lower bound of recall at or above 0.90, then the fewest false alerts. Twin attributions in the phrases are measured, not assumed: at 0.50 the seven false alerts of `amount` are all one-off purchases, and `velocity` trips on payroll, seasonal trade and savings transfers. `annotations` are fractions of the delivered close-up of each state (anchor x, anchor y, label x, label y, text): positions and texts were remeasured against the delivered close-ups (rack-01..05, the travellings' arrival frames arbitrated by Arslane): 01 the amount blade pulled out, 02 the counting blade, 03 the brass line over the three left blades, 04 the written and synthetic pair, 05 the whole rack with the eighth, ivory piece pulled. Two labels changed because the framed piece changed what a viewer can count: in 01 the amount blade half-hides its own amber row, so the label no longer counts seven diodes, and in 02 the false alerts read as a grid, not a row. Every label is 60 characters or fewer, per the builder's rule.

findings.titre: The amount scenario alone reaches 95.2% recall at 16.7% false alerts.
findings.phrase: Scoring only the largest amount in the window reaches 95.2% recall on the 42 written suspicious cases. It alerts on 16.7% of the benign twins, and each of those is a one-off family purchase the history explains.
findings.leg_a: recall 95.2% for the amount scenario at 0.50, interval [84–99], 42 written suspicious cases
findings.leg_b: false alerts 16.7% on 42 benign twins, interval [8–31]

findings.titre: The velocity scenario reaches 28.6% recall and alerts on half the twins.
findings.phrase: Counting transactions reaches 28.6% recall, since most written cases are not the busiest accounts. The same count alerts on half the benign twins, which are payroll, seasonal trade and monthly savings.
findings.leg_a: recall 28.6% for the velocity scenario at 0.50, interval [17–44]
findings.leg_b: false alerts 50% at the same threshold, interval [36–64], 42 benign twins

findings.titre: No single scenario reaches the 90% recall floor.
findings.phrase: The tool asks the lower bound of measured recall to reach 90%. On the 42 written cases no single scenario reaches it: the best lower bound is 84.2% for amount, the next 75% for peer. More than one scenario is needed.
findings.leg_a: highest recall lower bound, amount at 0.50: 84.2%, interval [84–99]
findings.leg_b: next best lower bound, peer at 0.50: 75%, interval [75–95]
annotations: recall floor 90%: unmet by any scenario

findings.titre: The amount scenario scores 100% recall on variants against 95.2% on written cases.
findings.phrase: The same cell scores 95.2% recall on the 42 written cases and 100% on the 126 generated variants. The generated set is easier, so it is measured on its own and never merged into the headline rate.
findings.leg_a: recall 95.2% for amount at 0.50 on 42 written suspicious cases, interval [84–99]
findings.leg_b: recall 100% at the same cell on 126 generated variants, interval [97–100]

findings.titre: The public record holds 42 written cases and 126 generated variants.
findings.phrase: Every case behind these findings is in the public record: 42 written, seven per typology, and 126 generated under a seed. Two files from your systems, alerts and transactions, rerun the full grid at your desk.
findings.leg_a: written suspicious cases behind the measured rates, seven per declared typology
findings.leg_b: generated variants behind the separate rates, typologies preserved by construction
annotations: your cases rerun at your desk
